## Purpose
Renders the site footer content from a configured HTML string, or a skeleton while loading. It returns nothing when no content is provided.

## Key concepts
- `Footer({content, loading})` returns `null` when `content` is falsy.
- Content is injected via `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`; skeleton from [[src-utils]].

## Gotchas
- Footer HTML is rendered unsanitized, so the config value must be trusted.
